title: Assalaam Aon o Mohd
body:
assalaam aun-o-mohd assalaam
<<DIVIDER>>
deen-e-ahmed ki baqa ke waaste
margaye zainab ke dono laadle
<<MINI>>
karke matam kehte hain sheh ke ghulaam
assalaam aun-o-mohd assalaam
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha bhulenge ye ahle aza
saniye zehra ke betou'n par bukaa
karte jayenge sada matam bapa
<<MINI>>
karke matam kehte hain sheh ke ghulaam
assalaam aun-o-mohd assalaam
<<DIVIDER>>
lashkar e shabbir ke shams o qamar
zainab-e-muztar ke hain noor e nazar
jaa'n fida karke gaye hai'n deen par
<<MINI>>
karke matam kehte hain sheh ke ghulaam
assalaam aun-o-mohd assalaam
<<DIVIDER>>
teen din ki pyaas me wo walwale
neemchou se din ulat ke rakhdiye
karbala dekhe na aise maareke
<<MINI>>
karke matam kehte hain sheh ke ghulaam
assalaam aun-o-mohd assalaam
<<DIVIDER>>
saniye zehra ke ye laqte jigar
hoke zaqmi jab gire hai'n qaak par
chaand se chere the dono khoo'n me tar
<<MINI>>
karke matam kehte hain sheh ke ghulaam
assalaam aun-o-mohd assalaam
<<DIVIDER>>
dee sada fizza ne rokar ya khuda
laaye jab lashou ko shaahe karbala
gham se madar ka kaleja phat gaya
<<MINI>>
karke matam kehte hai'n sheh ke ghulaam
assalaam aun-o-mohd assalaam
<<DIVIDER>>
darmiya'n laashou ke zainab diljali
shukrka sajda ada karne lagi
dekhkar rone lage aale nabi
<<MINI>>
karke matam kehte hain sheh ke ghulaam
assalaam aun-o-mohd assalaam
<<DIVIDER>>
lashou pa kehne lagi binte ali
bin tere kaise guzaru'n zindagi kyun na pehle margayi madar teri
<<MINI>>
karke matam kehte hain sheh ke ghulaam
assalaam aun-o-mohd assalaam
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye saqqa-e-haram ki anjuman
nouha padhti hai yahi runj o mehan
saniye zehra ka ujda hai chaman
<<MINI>>
karke matam kehte hain sheh ke ghulaam
assalaam aun-o-mohd assalaam
<<DIVIDER>>
ya hussain ibne ali shere khuda
sab ko dikhla dijiye rouza tera
karta hai anwar yahi ek ilteja
<<MINI>>
karke matam kehte hain sheh ke ghulaam
assalaam aun-o-mohd assalaam
